sentences.en: Old and young, we are all on our last cruise.
sentences.zh: 无论老少，我们都在进行最后一次航游。

sentences.en: Congratulations! You just won a free cruise to the Bahamas!
sentences.zh: 恭喜你！你赢得了去巴哈马的免费航游。

sentences.en: Some cruise ships throw their trash directly into the sea.
sentences.zh: 有些游轮会直接将垃圾丢入海中。
